
```{r}
# Initialize filenames
swl_qced_phenotypes_filename <- "swl_qced_phenotypes.csv"
raine_qced_phenotypes_filename <- "raine_qced_phenotypes.csv"

swl_wrist_weekly_summaries_filename <- "swl_wrist_weekly_summaries.csv"
swl_thigh_weekly_summaries_filename <- "swl_thigh_weekly_summaries.csv"
raine_wrist_weekly_summarie_filename <- "raine_wrist_weekly_summaries.csv"
raine_hip_weekly_summaries_filename <- "raine_hip_weekly_summaries.csv"

# Create output directories if they don't exist
invisible(lapply(c(
  here("output", "prepared", "tables"),
  here("output", "prepared", "figures")
), dir.create, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE))
```

# Load and prep QCed data

```{r}
# Load physical activity data
dat_swl_qced <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "intermediate", swl_qced_phenotypes_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

dat_raine_qced <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "intermediate", raine_qced_phenotypes_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

# Convert MVPA from hours to mins
dat_swl_qced <- dat_swl_qced %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("mvpa"), ~ .x * 60))

dat_raine_qced <- dat_raine_qced %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("mvpa"), ~ .x * 60))
```

# Table S3: Sensitivity correlations

## Repeat main results

```{r}
phenotypes <- c("overall_activity_mean",
                "steps_mean",
                "cadence_peak1_mean",
                "mvpa_mean",
                "lipa_mean",
                "sedentary_mean")

corr_results_main <- data.frame(study = character(),
                                phenotype = character(),
                                corr = character(),
                                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (phenotype in phenotypes) {
  # Calculate correlations for each study
  corr_swl <- calculate_corr(dat_swl_qced,
                             paste0(phenotype, "_wrist"),
                             paste0(phenotype, "_thigh"),
                             is_skewed = startsWith(phenotype, "mvpa"))
  
  corr_raine <- calculate_corr(dat_raine_qced, 
                               paste0(phenotype, "_wrist"),
                               paste0(phenotype, "_hip"),
                               is_skewed = startsWith(phenotype, "mvpa"))
  
  # Collate results
  corr_results_main <- rbind(
    corr_results_main,
    data.frame(study = "swl",
               phenotype = phenotype,
               corr = format_est(corr_swl$corr_est, 
                                 corr_swl$corr_lci,
                                 corr_swl$corr_uci,
                                 sep="-"),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    data.frame(study = "raine",
               phenotype = phenotype,
               corr = format_est(corr_raine$corr_est, 
                                 corr_raine$corr_lci,
                                 corr_raine$corr_uci,
                                 sep="-"),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    )
  
}
```

## Stringent quality control

```{r}
# Remove participants with imperfect wear
dat_swl_qced_stringent <- dat_swl_qced %>%
  filter(num_days_wrist == 8 & num_days_thigh == 8)

dat_raine_qced_stringent <- dat_raine_qced %>%
  filter(num_days_wrist == 8 & num_days_hip == 8)

phenotypes <- c("overall_activity_mean",
                "steps_mean",
                "cadence_peak1_mean",
                "mvpa_mean",
                "lipa_mean",
                "sedentary_mean")

# Get results
corr_results_qc <- data.frame(study = character(),
                              phenotype = character(),
                              corr = character(),
                              stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (phenotype in phenotypes) {
  
  # Calculate correlations for each study
  corr_swl <- calculate_corr(dat_swl_qced_stringent,
                             paste0(phenotype, "_wrist"),
                             paste0(phenotype, "_thigh"),
                             is_skewed = startsWith(phenotype, "mvpa"))
    
  corr_raine <- calculate_corr(dat_raine_qced_stringent, 
                               paste0(phenotype, "_wrist"),
                               paste0(phenotype, "_hip"),
                               is_skewed = startsWith(phenotype, "mvpa"))
  
  # Collate results
  corr_results_qc <- rbind(
    corr_results_qc,
    data.frame(study = "swl",
               phenotype = phenotype,
               corr = format_est(corr_swl$corr_est, 
                                 corr_swl$corr_lci,
                                 corr_swl$corr_uci,
                                 sep="-"),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    data.frame(study = "raine",
               phenotype = phenotype,
               corr = format_est(corr_raine$corr_est, 
                                 corr_raine$corr_lci,
                                 corr_raine$corr_uci,
                                 sep="-"),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    )
}
```

## Proportion of wear time

```{r}
phenos_to_transform <- c("overall_activity_mean",
                         "steps_mean",
                         "mvpa_mean",
                         "lipa_mean",
                         "sedentary_mean")

# Create wear_time_daily variable
dat_swl_qced$wear_time_daily_thigh <-
  dat_swl_qced$wear_time_hours_thigh / dat_swl_qced$num_days_thigh

dat_raine_qced$wear_time_daily_hip <-
  dat_raine_qced$wear_time_hours_hip / dat_raine_qced$num_days_hip

# Express thigh/hip phenotypes as proportions of wear time
pat_swl <- paste0("^(", paste(phenos_to_transform, collapse = "|"), ")_thigh$")
pat_raine <- paste0("^(", paste(phenos_to_transform, collapse = "|"), ")_hip$")

dat_swl_proportions <- dat_swl_qced %>%
  mutate(across(matches(pat_swl), ~ . * 24 / wear_time_daily_thigh))

dat_raine_proportions <- dat_raine_qced %>%
  mutate(across(matches(pat_raine), ~ . * 16 / wear_time_daily_hip))

# Get results
corr_results_proportions <- data.frame(study = character(),
                                       phenotype = character(),
                                       corr = character(),
                                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

phenotypes <- c("overall_activity_mean",
                "steps_mean",
                "cadence_peak1_mean",
                "mvpa_mean",
                "lipa_mean",
                "sedentary_mean")

for (phenotype in phenotypes) {
  # Calculate correlations for each study
  corr_swl <- calculate_corr(dat_swl_proportions,
                             paste0(phenotype, "_wrist"),
                             paste0(phenotype, "_thigh"),
                             is_skewed = startsWith(phenotype, "mvpa"))
    
  corr_raine <- calculate_corr(dat_raine_proportions, 
                               paste0(phenotype, "_wrist"),
                               paste0(phenotype, "_hip"),
                               is_skewed = startsWith(phenotype, "mvpa"))
  
  # Collate results
  corr_results_proportions <- rbind(
    corr_results_proportions,
    data.frame(study = "swl",
               phenotype = phenotype,
               corr = format_est(corr_swl$corr_est, 
                                 corr_swl$corr_lci,
                                 corr_swl$corr_uci,
                                 sep="-"),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    data.frame(study = "raine",
               phenotype = phenotype,
               corr = format_est(corr_raine$corr_est, 
                                 corr_raine$corr_lci,
                                 corr_raine$corr_uci,
                                 sep="-"),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    )
}
```

## Collate results into table

```{r}
# Change names of columns
names(corr_results_main)[names(corr_results_main) == "corr"] <- "corr_main"
names(corr_results_qc)[names(corr_results_qc) == "corr"] <- "corr_qc"
names(corr_results_median)[names(corr_results_median) == "corr"] <- "corr_median"
names(corr_results_proportions)[names(corr_results_proportions) == "corr"] <- "corr_proportions"

# Remove string suffix
corr_results_main <- corr_results_main %>%
  mutate(phenotype = sub("_(mean|median)$", "", phenotype))
corr_results_qc <- corr_results_qc %>%
  mutate(phenotype = sub("_(mean|median)$", "", phenotype))
corr_results_median <- corr_results_median %>%
  mutate(phenotype = sub("_(mean|median)$", "", phenotype))
corr_results_proportions <- corr_results_proportions %>%
  mutate(phenotype = sub("_(mean|median)$", "", phenotype))

# Merge all dataframes
corr_results_sensitivity <- list(corr_results_main,
                                corr_results_qc,
                                corr_results_median,
                                corr_results_proportions) %>%
  purrr::reduce(inner_join, by = c("study", "phenotype")) %>%
  mutate(study = factor(study, levels = c("swl", "raine"))) %>%
  arrange(study)

# Save table to .docx
ft <- regulartable(corr_results_sensitivity) %>%
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") %>%
  set_table_properties(layout = "fixed", width = 1) %>%
  autofit()

doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft)

print(doc, target = here("output", "prepared", "tables", "Table_S3.docx"))
```

# Figure S10: Scatter plots with 24h hip-based phenotypes

```{r}
# Load data
dat_raine_hip_24h <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "intermediate", "raine_hip_weekly_summaries.csv"),
  data.table = FALSE
)

# Select the same participants for 24h scatter plots
dat_raine_hip_24h <- dat_raine_hip_24h %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_hip"), -pid) %>%
  semi_join(dat_raine_qced, by = "filename_hip") %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("mvpa"), ~ .x * 60))

dat_raine_qced_24h <- dat_raine_qced %>%
  select(-ends_with("_hip")) %>%
  left_join(dat_raine_hip_24h, by = "pid")

# Prepare individual scatter plots for Raine
plot1 <- make_scatter_plot(dat_raine_qced_24h,
                           phenotype = 'overall_activity_mean',
                           title = 'Overall activity',
                           phenotype_units = 'mg/day',
                           axes_lims = c(0, 60))

plot2 <- make_scatter_plot(dat_raine_qced_24h,
                           phenotype = 'steps_mean',
                           title = 'Step count',
                           phenotype_units = 'steps/day',
                           axes_lims = c(0, 30000))

plot3 <- make_scatter_plot(dat_raine_qced_24h,
                           phenotype = 'cadence_peak1_mean',
                           title = 'Peak 1-min cadence',
                           phenotype_units = 'steps/minute',
                           axes_lims = c(40, 180))

plot4 <- make_scatter_plot(dat_raine_qced_24h,
                           phenotype = 'mvpa_mean',
                           title = 'MVPA',
                           phenotype_units = 'minutes/day',
                           skewed_phenotype = TRUE,
                           axes_lims = c(0, 200))

plot5 <- make_scatter_plot(dat_raine_qced_24h,
                           phenotype = 'lipa_mean',
                           title = 'Light physical activity',
                           phenotype_units = 'hours/day',
                           axes_lims = c(0, 12))

plot6 <- make_scatter_plot(dat_raine_qced_24h,
                           phenotype = 'sedentary_mean',
                           title = 'Sedentary behaviour',
                           phenotype_units = 'hours/day',
                           axes_lims = c(0, 20))

# Combine all Raine plots
figure <- arrangeGrob(ggplotGrob(plot1),
                       ggplotGrob(plot2),
                       ggplotGrob(plot3),
                       ggplotGrob(plot4),
                       ggplotGrob(plot5),
                       ggplotGrob(plot6),
                       ncol = 3)

# Save figure to file
ggsave(filename = here("output", "prepared", "figures", "Figure_S10.png"),
       plot = figure,
       width = 21,
       height = 14,
       units = "cm",
       dpi = 300,
       bg = "white")
```
